listing.name: Kameo: Elements of Power — Azkali KameoRecomp (Azkali)
listing.summary: Research project. Early bring-up: codegen produces a linkable Kameo target; most kernel imports stubbed in src/hooks.cpp. Boot/gameplay not claimed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Xbox360 Kameo ISO extracted with extract-xiso into assets/game/ containing default.xex and the remaining game files. Exact accepted region/revision/executable digest not established.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source route: build/install ReXGlueSDK, run rexglue codegen Kameo_config.toml, configure LinuxAMD64 CMake preset with REXSDK_DIR and compile using Clang18+/CMake3.25+/Ninja. No player runtime release asserted.

warnings: Early bring-up: codegen produces a linkable Kameo target; most kernel imports stubbed in src/hooks.cpp. Boot/gameplay not claimed.
